description: Report an event for one of your users from your own backend, by the customer_user_id your app passed to AttriKit.setUserID; no device installation id is needed. The event is attached to the install that id resolves to and reaches the destinations whose sender for its family is Your servers. Requires a write-scoped API key. Answers status accepted, duplicate (this event_id was already stored) or suppressed (consent.measurement is not granted, so nothing was collected), with the install_epoch_id it resolved to. 404 customer_user_not_found means no install identified with this id.

consent.description: The per-event consent SDK events carry. An event whose measurement is not granted is not collected.

dma.description: Optional. The user's answers to Google's EU consent questions, sent to Google with this event. A value left out is derived from tracking; an unknown key is refused, as the API refuses it.

eea.description: Whether EEA, UK or Swiss rules apply to this user.

measurement.description: The user's measurement consent: granted, denied or unknown. Only a granted event is collected.

policy_version.description: The version of the consent policy the user answered, a positive integer.

tracking.description: The user's tracking consent: granted, denied or unknown.

customer_user_id.description: The opaque id your app passed to AttriKit.setUserID. Refused when it looks like an email address or phone number. Hashed on arrival, never stored.

event_id.description: Your id for this event. A second event with the same id is a duplicate and is not written again.

event_name.description: Canonical event name, for example purchase or subscription_started.

event_version.description: The version of this event's definition, a positive integer. The SDKs send 1 by default.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

properties.description: Scalar values only, at most 64 keys. Revenue is value (major units) or price_minor_units with currency, an ISO 4217 code.

name: send_server_event
title: Report an event from your backend
